(Rest assured I will check with my doctor before taking.) One thing that helped me was doing some stuff to lengthen my cycle (acupuncture and taking vitamin B12 and C), but I still have a ways to go to get to "healthy" ferritin levels. KF • 1d What the heck with the psychic connection...I literally printed that chicken/pesto recipe YESTERDAY while poking around for some new dinner options! Glad to hear it's actually a keeper! Cookies are a classic lunchbox treat, after school snack, and teacher or bus driver gift. If you’re thinking about lunchbox treats or after school snacks, I’ve collected more than FORTY of my family’s favorite Zoë François ∙ 28 LIKES ∙ 1 RESTACKS Jan in VA • Aug 19 LOVE my Thermopen. Amy Allen • 6d Exciting that Cookie Queen is almost here! Thanks for this--your sheet pan ratatouille was in heavy rotation last summer and I must make it soon. buttermilk weekly Sep 5 sourdough spotlight: beignets & muffins + flour matters for cookie spread For fall season, I’m sharing two recipes a week (double the usual). I used to love cosmic brownies growing up but not gonna lie, they’re even better homemade and in cookie form. I’m not sure why I’m struggling so much to acclimate this time around, but wow, it’s been way rougher than usual! It uses my classic brown butter cookie dough base with a very generous amount of cinnamon, butter and sugar swirled throughout (think the filling of a cinnamon bun). The ripples of cinnamon sugar caramelise in the oven, resulting in a cri… Kofi ∙ 63 LIKES ∙ 3 RESTACKS Kate • Aug 21 CREAM CHEESE ICE CREAM COOKIE SANDWICH 🍪🍪🍪🍪 Hessa • 7d Is it 120g of butter before or after browning it? Should we add ice cubes after browning, like your past recipes, until it reaches 120g? Read all 9 comments Spill The Sauce Aug 15 the cookie drop that you'll want to take notes on my brown butter salted chocolate chip cookie recipe is finally here !! By far my most requested recipe is my chocolate chip cookies. But they’re not just any chocolate chip cookie… they’re a brown butter salted chocolate chip cookie. Yeah you heard that right. Emily Rose ∙ 23 LIKES Harper Miller • Aug 15 Best cookies Kelley • Aug 19 Hi! Salted or unsalted butter? If you love Nutella, these cupcakes are about to become your new obsession. The Breakfast Nook Sep 8 Breaking Baking — Batch 04: Concentrated Brown Sugar Taking brown sugar past dark and 3 recipes to put it to work. When I use brown sugar, I don’t think too much about it. I simply get the amount I need for the recipe and carry on. Half the time, I can’t even tell you whether I have light or dark brown sugar in my pantry. Miles Ware ∙ 16 LIKES Malaka Hampton • 2d Loved this breakdown! Two sugars I would put in the brown sugar category are muscovado and piloncillo. Miles Ware • 2d Thank you! And you’re so right. I actually thought about mentioning muscovado and was going to include it in my testing, but I learned that its produced differently so I left it out for consistency. Will probably still mess around with it in my free time though haha.
